verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same crop of the wrapped hand, and that crop drops the torso and arm that give the original its power. Both also leave the LUST/FOR/WIN lockup small and pushed nearly to the side edges of the narrow canvas, with the letter-spaced WIN running close to both sides. A's LUST runs almost to the right edge and its dotted rule sits farther below WIN than in the original. B keeps the dot row tight under WIN as the original does and centres the lockup slightly better, so it edges ahead.
